ecosystemFit.reasoning: CMC Visuals is the operational proof-of-concept for SubjectSkillz — the creator pipeline that supplies Subject Media production capacity. Every CMC sale generates SR upsell potential and validates the SubjectSkillz onboarding model.
strengthens: Subject Report (SR transcript upsell on every delivery)

yearOneEstimate.assumptions: Based on 19 orders / ~$2,049 in ~5 months. Assumes 3-4 events/month at average ticket $120. High includes Team Elite deals + subscriptions + SR upsell at 15% conversion.

risks.risk: Creator is a minor — consent exposure on footage of other minors
risks.mitigation: Parental consent at checkout (built). Privacy policy + ToS (built). Parent controls Connect account (built). No public posting without consent verification.

risks.risk: Single creator = single point of failure
risks.mitigation: SubjectSkillz bench-building is the fix. CMC's success is the case study.

risks.risk: Central Stripe account restriction stops all creator payouts
risks.mitigation: Stripe Connect Express sub-accounts per creator. Never commingle SR and creator-network revenue.

risks.risk: Subscription churn if community isn't actively programmed
risks.mitigation: HL bridge automates access. Cohorts and 1-on-1s (human layer) are the retention mechanism.

nextStageInputs: Stage 3 (WorldBuild Bible) needs: creator real name or brand identity preference, tone/voice direction (personal brand vs faceless company), existing brand assets (logo confirmed?), SR upsell timing (48hr or 72hr post-delivery).
